baseline_note: Six synthetic, hand-labelled cases, and eleven whose candidates are the 64 rows source_code_context returned on this repository for a commit's subject, the relevant rows being the symbols its diff changed. Measured 2026-10-21 with protocol openai, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 (local ninfer), model systemone-decision-v7. The Workcell order that the feature falls back to scored nDCG@k 0.123 and recall@k 0.183 on the same cases; judging only the first 16 scored nDCG@k 0.560 and recall@k 0.553.
